set.body:
Lower StudyAnalysisPlan into the generic pipeline layer using small descriptors and artifact references, with execution semantics independent of any cluster framework.

Scope:
- Compile ingest, first-level preparation, spatial work, sink finalization, catalog handoff, group work, and second-level finalization into an acyclic PipelineGraph.
- Keep matrices and open readers out of ArtifactTable; resolve them through typed capabilities at execution boundaries.
- Provide reference sequential and bounded-parallel interpreters with a shared resource budget so subject-level and block-level parallelism do not oversubscribe.
- Record durable receipts for deterministic work IDs, attempts, inputs, outputs, failures, and provenance; support retry and resume from committed artifacts.
- Specify the adapter seam for future process, cluster, or remote execution without adding Spark or scheduler types to shared modules.

Acceptance:
- The same plan runs sequentially and with bounded parallelism and produces equivalent ordered manifests.
- Failure injection demonstrates retry, idempotent commit, resume, and no duplicate finalized outputs.
- Resource tests prove the configured concurrency budget is respected across nested parallel axes.
- A serialized plan plus catalogs and configuration is sufficient to resume in a fresh process.
set.title: Workflow orchestration: lower study plans to resumable execution policies
